content.text:
condition: Available
        timeout: 600s
      - resource: deployment
        namespace: harbor
        name: harbor-jobservice
        condition: Available
        timeout: 600s
      - resource: deployment
        namespace: harbor
        name: harbor-exporter
        condition: Available
        timeout: 600s

  hosting-charts:
    type: hostingCharts
    chartsDir: ../../../hosting_apps
    registryHost: apps-registry.localdev.me
    project: smartcityhub
    username: admin
    passwordSecret: harbor/harbor-core:HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD
    plainHttp: true

  hosting-runtime:
    type: helm
    releaseName: sch-hosting-runtime
    chart: platform_support/hosting_runtime
    timeout: 5m
    wait: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/hosting_runtime.values.yaml

  hosting-cnpg:
    type: helm
    releaseName: sch-hosting-cnpg
    chart: platform_infra/infrastructure/cnpg_cluster
    timeout: 10m
    wait: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/hosting_cnpg.values.yaml
    postInstallWaits:
      - resource: cluster.postgresql.cnpg.io
        name: hosting-cnpg
        condition: Ready
        timeout: 600s
      - resource: deployment
        name: hosting-cnpg-pooler-rw
        condition: Available
        timeout: 300s

  services:
    type: helm
    releaseName: sch-platform-services
    chart: custom_services/sch_services
    valuesKeys:
      - keycloak-sidecar-backend
      - data-viewer-backend
      - data-viewer-web-ui
      - hosting-web-ui
      - portal-web-ui
      - data-store-backend
      - events-backend
      - file-store
      - portal-backend
      - data-market-backend
      - data-market-web-ui
      - headless-cms-proxy
      - digital-kiosk-content-provider
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/images.values.yaml
        optional: true
      - path: environments/local/services.values.yaml

  core-airflow:
    type: helm
    enabled: true
    releaseName: sch-core-airflow
    chart: core_apps/airflow
    valuesKeys:
      - airflow
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/core_apps.values.yaml

  core-mobilizon:
    type: helm
    enabled: true
    releaseName: sch-core-mobilizon
    chart: core_apps/mobilizon
    valuesKeys:
      - mobilizon
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/core_apps.values.yaml

  core-dsg:
    type: helm
    enabled: true
    releaseName: sch-core-dsg
    chart: core_apps/dsg
    valuesKeys:
      - dsg
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/core_apps.values.yaml

  core-wikijs:
    type: helm
    enabled: true
    releaseName: sch-core-wikijs
    chart: core_apps/wikijs
    valuesKeys:
      - wikijs
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/core_apps.values.yaml

  core-headless-cms:
    type: helm
    enabled: true
    releaseName: sch-core-headless-cms
    chart: core_apps/headless_cms
    valuesKeys:
      - headless-cms
    timeout: 20m
    waitForJobs: true
    values:
      - path: environments/local/shared.values.yaml
      - path: environments/local/images.values.yaml
        optional: true
      - path: environments/local/core_apps.values.yaml
